title: Asymptotic Root Dynamics under Repeated and Fractional Integration
summary: Fix a polynomial $P(x)=\sum_{j=0}^m a_jx^j$ of degree $m$, and let $I_kP$ be its $k$-fold antiderivative with all integration constants zero. Borwein, Chen, and Dilcher proved that, after $x=ky$, the nonzero zeros of $I_kP$ converge to the nonzero zeros of $L[P](y)=\sum_j a_j j! y^j$. That convergence determines the leading linear motion but neither the constant offset nor successive differences. We compute the next two terms at a simple nonzero zero $λ$ of $L[P]$.
